Projects.Name: AWS.AgentCore.Hosting
ChangelogMessages: Added OpenTelemetry instrumentation for traces, metrics, and logs. Wraps IChatClient and AIAgent with Microsoft Agent Framework's OpenTelemetry decorators and exports via OTLP. Configurable via the AgentCoreOptions.ConfigureTracing/ConfigureMetrics/ConfigureLogging callbacks; opt out via DisableObservability.
